Enough is enough.

We introduced the Third World Immigration Moratorium Act to slam the door shut and ban aliens from dozens of third world countries from entering the United States.

We’re tired of watching American families pay the price while bad actors exploit every gap in our system.

America is not a dumping ground for the third world’s problems. Entry into America is a privilege, not a right.

We will ALWAYS put America first. No apologies.
